messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout wave=2 started (release=2026.03.15.09). Automated healthchecks: eu-west-1 showing elevated 5xx. 5xx rate=12% over 5m. Pausing further waves and alerting.
emma (on-call): seeing the alert, paging SRE. @raj can you take a look?
raj (sre): on it. opening the canary dashboard: https://dash.redwood.com/d/rollout/canary-eu-west — backend 502s coming from kv-store downstream, not CPU.
raj (sre): plan: (1) flip routing gate away from new kv path, (2) scale legacy-kv to absorb traffic, (3) abort canary if error rate doesn't drop in 3m.
ops-bot: feature-gate-toggle new-kv-routing -> off (requested by raj)
ops-bot: command run: /feature toggle new-kv-routing off — response: ok
raj (sre): scaling legacy-kv: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy/legacy-kv --replicas=6` (manual bump to drain pressure)
emma (on-call): any immediate customer impact? can CS confirm?
customer-success: we have 3 inbound tickets from EU customers reporting slow responses; no major SLA breaches yet but tickets mention occasional 502.
raj (sre): abort criteria met (5xx > 10% sustained 3m). Initiating canary abort and rollback: `controller rollout abort --id=canary-20260315-wave2`
deploy-bot: Rollout abort accepted for canary-20260315-wave2. Draining canary instances, will stop traffic shift. ETA ~3m.
emma (on-call): running quick smoke once drain completes: `curl -i https://eu.api.redwood.com/health | jq .status`
raj (sre): smoke after rollback: status=ok; 5xx dropped to 0.8% over last 2m. Leaving circuit breaker (routing gate) OFF for at least 15m while we monitor.
emma (on-call): opening incident ticket INC-20260315-42, please add timeline + commands used. Also notify support team and flag for postmortem.
raj (sre): added timeline and logs to INC-20260315-42. Root cause appears to be a mismatch in kv client timeouts under the new routing path; collecting heap/timeout traces now.
emma (on-call): handoff: I'm handing this to chris for night watch. Summary for next oncall: rolled back wave2 due to kv-store 502 surge, feature gate `new-kv-routing` toggled OFF, legacy-kv scaled x -> 6, minor customer tickets (3). Keep watch for >2% 5xx or ticket volume spike.
chris (oncall-next): taking it. I'll keep the dashboard pinned, watch the error rate, and escalate to backend eng if >2% persists for 5m. Runbook: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/canary-rollback
emma (on-call): thanks all :thumbsup: tagging postmortem owner @raj to lead RCA. ops-bot: remind in 24h to start postmortem draft.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: create-postmortem INC-20260315-42 in 24h.
